description: Human-curated summaries for regression evaluation, not verbatim official abstracts. Synthetic cases test unfamiliar terminology and untrusted text.

cases.name: rfc9635
cases.title: Grant Negotiation and Authorization Protocol (GNAP)
cases.abstract: A client negotiates access to resources and the authorization server issues access tokens based on the resource owner's interaction.

cases.name: rfc9767
cases.title: Grant Negotiation and Authorization Protocol Resource Server Connections
cases.abstract: Defines interactions between resource servers and authorization servers to validate access tokens and enforce access rights.

cases.name: rfc7636
cases.title: Proof Key for Code Exchange
cases.abstract: Binds an authorization request to the client redeeming its code to mitigate interception attacks.

cases.name: rfc7519
cases.title: JSON Web Token
cases.abstract: A compact claims representation with signatures used to convey assertions between parties.

cases.name: rfc9449
cases.title: OAuth 2.0 Demonstrating Proof of Possession
cases.abstract: Binds access tokens to a client's key and requires request-specific signed proofs.

cases.name: rfc8555
cases.title: Automatic Certificate Management Environment
cases.abstract: Automates verification of control of identifiers and issuance of certificates binding identifiers to public keys.

cases.name: rfc9334
cases.title: Remote ATtestation procedureS Architecture
cases.abstract: An attester supplies evidence to a verifier; relying parties use appraisal results to decide whether to trust a device.

cases.name: synthetic-unfamiliar
cases.title: Service Entry Tickets
cases.abstract: A holder receives a signed ticket describing which operations it may perform. A service verifies the ticket before granting access. Tickets may delegate a subset of permitted operations.

cases.name: rfc5905
cases.title: Network Time Protocol Version 4
cases.abstract: Specifies clock synchronization, timestamp exchanges and clock selection between Internet hosts.

cases.name: rfc4271
cases.title: A Border Gateway Protocol 4
cases.abstract: Exchanges network reachability information between autonomous systems to select routing paths.

cases.name: rfc1035
cases.title: Domain Names Implementation and Specification
cases.abstract: Defines DNS message formats, resource records, resolvers and name server operation.
